تتذاكري (form VI)
# تَتَذَاكَرِي (tataḏākarī) /ta.ta.ðaː.ka.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تُتَذَاكَرِي (tutaḏākarī) /tu.ta.ðaː.ka.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
